title: Choose Righton's visual world
question: The roll assigned Departures Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Departures Board
options.lineage: Bole International flight-information displays and airport wayfinding
options.thesis: Every vacancy is a departure: a ref, a destination city, a closing time, a live status.
options.viewport: A full-bleed terminal-light photograph, headline and Find work / Hire through Righton on the left, a live blue Openings board with flipping rows on the right, search docked under it.
options.risk: Becomes airport costume if pictograms, gates and flap noise spread beyond the board itself.

raised.raise: Hierarchy by type scale alone: no icon tiles, no pills, no card shells around listings.
Blue owns whole regions: the board is a drenched blue field, not blue accents on white.
Counts and days-left sit in fixed-width digit cells that change as one physical flip.
Every listing carries its provenance line: ref, received from client, published by Righton.

options.label: Vacancy Announcement
options.lineage: Boxed vacancy ads in The Reporter and Addis Zemen classifieds
options.thesis: The portal as the classifieds page Ethiopians have read jobs from for decades, set with modern precision.
options.viewport: A broadsheet grid of boxed vacancy announcements, the newest set large as the lead ad beside a halftone workplace photo and the two actions.
options.risk: The familiar editorial-newspaper move many runs land on; reads dated if set timidly.

options.label: Variable-font specimen
options.thesis: Job titles set as a living specimen, scale doing all the work.
options.viewport: One giant job title morphing weight as you scroll the list.
options.risk: Typography spectacle that seekers don't recognise as a job board.
options.case: Fuses poorly: seekers don't identify with type specimens; clarity drops.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale alone, no ornament.

options.label: Soundsystem dance poster
options.thesis: Vacancies billed like sounds, ranked by weight in block caps.
options.viewport: Outlined block-cap job titles stacked by deadline.
options.risk: Breaks the pinned white-and-blue palette and the trust register.
options.case: Fuses poorly: loud for a CV-trusting audience; palette conflicts with the brief.
options.kept: Total palette commitment at page scale.

options.label: Nixie laboratory counter
options.thesis: Open vacancies and deadlines as glowing digit banks.
options.viewport: Digit banks counting open roles above the list.
options.risk: Counts are thin with a small board; reads as a gadget.
options.case: Fuses poorly: quantities aren't what seekers came for.
options.kept: Fixed digit positions; a count change is a physical event.

options.label: Memory quilt atlas
options.thesis: Each vacancy a pieced block with its own provenance.
options.viewport: A patch grid of vacancies seamed by sector.
options.risk: Domestic and sentimental; undermines a professional agency.
options.kept: Every block cites where it came from.

options.label: Tensegrity column
options.thesis: Hiring as balanced forces between seekers and employers.
options.viewport: A strut network with roles pinned to nodes.
options.risk: Abstract; a job list doesn't map to a force diagram.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no audience recognition, low clarity.
options.kept: Every value labelled precisely with its unit.

options.label: Video store wall
options.thesis: Sectors as aisles, filled roles as empty slots with a tag.
options.viewport: A shelf of vacancy spines by sector.
options.risk: Nostalgia foreign to the Ethiopian audience.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no audience identification; browsing spines slows applying.
options.kept: Absence as an honest state: closed roles stay visible as closed.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Welcome-to-the-Jungle-grade job board: editorial photography, a clean list, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Photo hero with headline, two actions and search; a refined list and detail below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other portals by design.
